description:
They're tiny, they're invisible to the naked eye, and they're living all around you — even in your bed! 🛏️ Meet the house dust mite, a microscopic creature that thrives in warm, humid environments and feeds on flakes of human skin. In this video, we’ll explore:

🔬 What house dust mites are
🏠 Where they live and how they survive
🤧 How they affect allergies and asthma
🧼 Practical tips to reduce dust mites in your home

If you’ve ever wondered what’s really hiding in your pillows, carpets, and couches, this is the video for you. Discover the secret life of dust mites and how to protect yourself from these tiny intruders.

👉 Don’t forget to like, share, and subscribe for more fascinating science videos!

transcript: If you shake an old bed sheet, you will see dust flying around. If it gets inside, there are few people who do not sneeze. Some people will immediately start experiencing severe allergy symptoms. Not only sneezing, wheezing, runny nose, and headaches, sometimes the whole body will become cold and itchy, along with shortness of breath and asthma, and the situation will get out of hand.
